name: Rinkan Gakuen "Yamete! ...Okaa-san, Minaide!"
original_name: 輪奸学園「やめてっ！…お母さん、見ないで！」
source:
Main character is in charge of the elite class in the prestigious school. He uses his chemistry knowledge to drug students and turn them into meat slaves forming his harem. This spring there's a new beautiful student who transfers together with her mother as health teacher. Protagonist welcomes a new challenge.

[From [url=https://vndbreview.blogspot.com/2019/07/vn-of-month-march-2004-remember11-age.html]vndbreview[/url]]
translation:
主角是名校精英班的负责人。他利用自己的化学知识给学生下药，把他们变成肉奴隶，组成他的后宫。今年春天，新来了一位漂亮的学生，她和妈妈一起转校担任健康老师。主角迎接新的挑战。

[来自[url=https://vndbreview.blogspot.com/2019/07/vn-of-month-march-2004-remember11-age.html]vndbreview[/url]]
